learning_outcomes: Read and write numbers up to 10,000 in symbols and words.
Identify external structures of flowering plants in the immediate environment.

lessons.subject: Mathematics & Numeracy
lessons.topic: Place Value of Digits up to Thousands
lessons.parent_script: Ask: 'Look at the car registration number outside. Which digit is in the thousands place?'
lessons.learning_objective: Learner identifies thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones in 4-digit numbers with 95% accuracy.
local_materials: Dry maize seeds or bottle tops for counting
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Write three 4-digit numbers on paper.
2. Ask child to make place value columns (Th, H, T, O).
3. Group maize seeds into bundles of tens and hundreds.
